newsitem.title: USA: CalPERS, Florida fund seek changes at ADM.
newsitem.headline: CalPERS, Florida fund seek changes at ADM.

text.p: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) and the Florida Retirement System Trust Fund on Monday urged shareholders of Archer Daniels Midland Co to put a majority of independent directors on the company's board.

Archer Daniels's board "fails to meet even a watered-down version of independence," the funds said in a statement. "When outside directors who are also relatives, customers, suppliers and friends are asked to judge performance of the company and its management -- how 'independent' will they be?"
Archer Daniels has set its annual meeting for Oct. 17.
